title: AntennaPod Episode Daily Event Volume
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=antennapod:episode
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(podcast_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many AntennaPod episode events land each day and how many distinct podcast values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest AntennaPod episode records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct podcast values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much AntennaPod episode activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
